android.desc: End the morning chaos! The smart family alarm clock & kids alarm clock for stress-free mornings. FamWake is your all-in-one family routine planner, morning routine app, kids routine app, visual schedule planner, and task assignment app for families — morning schedule, bathroom queue, and visual timer routine in one simple app. Everyone needs to leave at the same time and someone always ends up late. That's why I built FamWake: the family alarm clock I always wished we had. Whether as a smart kids alarm, a helper for your morning routine for kids, or a shared schedule for couples and roommates — FamWake stops morning chaos and makes mornings easy. FamWake calculates the perfect wake-up time for each person — coordinated with bathroom turns, breakfast, and departure time. Everyone sleeps as long as possible, and nobody is late. No More Bathroom Queues End morning chaos with an intelligent routine. FamWake is a shared alarm clock, synchronized morning alarm clock, and group alarm that manages your bathroom schedule and bathroom queue automatically with zero overlaps and custom buffer times. A reliable group schedule ensures you only wake up when it's actually your turn. Family Breakfast Together Turn on the breakfast option and FamWake schedules a shared window where everyone sits down together before the day starts. Your Whole Family at a Glance The dashboard shows your family routine and family morning routine in real-time: who wakes up when, who is in the bathroom, and departure times. Rearrange the order with a simple drag & drop — your first then visual schedule, visual timer for kids free, visual habit tracker, and visual timer for autism, ideal as an ADHD visual routine planner for effortless morning planning, kids morning routine app management, and calm family starts. Flexible Weekdays & Vacation Mode • Day Profiles: Set custom wake-up times and school routines for every single day of the week. • Vacation Mode: Pause all timers and reminders until school starts again with one tap. Resumes automatically on day one! Gentle Wake-Up & Loud Ringtone Reliable wake-up calls even in silent mode. A 30-second gentle volume crescendo wakes kids calmly without shocking them awake. As a gentle kids alarm and visual timer, FamWake helps children build positive morning habits. Loud tones available for heavy sleepers. Evening Check-In & Already Awak
